data.gender_notes: Dil is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dil is derived from the Persian language, which means heart, love, and affection. In Islamic culture, the heart is considered the seat of emotions, thoughts, and beliefs. This name symbolizes love, kindness, and compassion towards others. The name Dil carries the meaning “Heart, affection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dil usually hope their child will grow to embody heart, affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the love and compassion of Allah towards His creation.
data.etymology: Dil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heart, affection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
